name: FiveStone

evidence.note: Band describes itself as a high-energy cover band playing classic rock, 80s/90s, pop, dance and party rock.
Booking profile tags it as a dance band, wedding band and Top 40 band.
Massapequa Park Street Fair on Oct 4 has three live bands playing all day.

dancing.notes: A party rock cover band that lists itself as a dance and wedding band. Its Oct 4 gig is the Massapequa Park street fair.

description: A Long Island five-piece party rock cover band playing classic rock, 80s and 90s, pop and dance hits at bars, festivals and weddings.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Ira's List venue 'Mass Park LIRR' seems to be the street fair on Park Blvd by the train station; band's own Oct 4 listing not checked. Not the same as '5 Stone', a classic rock trio.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Current values confirmed against the band's own site. Booking phone/email are the ones the band publishes for bookings (contact person named on the site as the singer). The band's upcoming-shows widget loads by script, so I could not see the Oct 4 Massapequa Park listing directly; past dates on the site include Prohibition at 109 Front St, Massapequa Park, which fits the Ira's List location. Images came from the site's image CDN as WebP. Skipped a Halloween costume photo and a duplicate promo shot. Current description is fine; not changed.

evidence.note: Band's own site: Long Island-based five-piece cover band (classic rock, 80s and 90s, pop, dance and party rock); also offers a 3-piece acoustic lineup; booking contact listed.

Show list is all Nassau County venues: Memories 2 (Williston Park), Sonny's Canal House (Baldwin), Lazy Lobster (East Rockaway), The Nutty Irishman (Farmingdale), Prohibition (Massapequa Park), Dirty Taco (Port Washington).
Contact page gives a booking phone and email published by the band.
Home page links the band's Facebook page and Instagram (@fivestoneband).
